holdout_card.fact_statement: Representatives from Jamaat-e-Islami attended a meeting convened by the Chief of Army Staff to discuss the creation of an interim government.
holdout_card.source_span: On 5 August, the Chief of Army Staff, Waker-uz-Zaman, convened a meeting with representatives from BNP, Jatiya Party (Ershad), and Jamaat-e-Islami and called for the creation of an interim government

qa_variants.question: Representatives from which political party attended a meeting convened by the Chief of Army Staff to discuss the creation of an interim government during the 2024 non-cooperation movement?
qa_variants.source_span: On 5 August, the Chief of Army Staff, Waker-uz-Zaman, convened a meeting with representatives from BNP, Jatiya Party (Ershad), and Jamaat-e-Islami and called for the creation of an interim government
